tasks.description: src/scene/Ocean.tsx renders a large subdivided plane rotated to XZ using the water material; time uniform ticks each frame.

tasks.description: src/scene/FloatingObjects.tsx places 3-5 simple floating objects that bob and tilt each frame by sampling sampleGerstner at their (x,z).
steps: All floaters visibly bob with the waves; Y closely matches ocean surface at their (x,z)
Floaters tilt along wave slope (not just translate)
No floater penetrates the ocean surface at rest

patterns: R3F v9 WebGPURenderer via async gl prop (Canvas gl={async props => { const r = new THREE.WebGPURenderer(props); await r.init(); return r; }})
Gerstner wave sum (GPU Gems 1 Ch.1) shared between TSL builder and CPU sampler for deterministic floater sync
Dual scrolling normal maps with RNB blend (pattern from three.js examples/webgpu_reflection.html)
drei Environment for HDR sky/reflection, drei OrbitControls
nonGoals: Caustics, foam, subsurface scattering, spray particles
